purpose: Teach: 陶器/アミノ酸/音符/管弦楽/画素/サンダル/ギタリスト/リアクション

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの陶器のカップ、可愛いね
lines.en: Sho, your sister thinks that ceramic cup of mine is really cute.
lines.style: Warm, observational. Soft opening. Speaking as if sharing a small noticing with him. Gentle pace, inviting him into a quiet moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、給食でアミノ酸入りの飲み物飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drank this drink at lunch that had amino acids in it.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo. The delight of telling someone something new he learned. Small voice but full of pride in the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お歌の音符を読めるようになったわね
lines.en: Sho, you've gotten really good at reading musical notes, haven't you.
lines.style: Noticing, warm. Steady gentle tone. Not a question but a reflection. The voice of someone who's watched him grow and is pleased.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、学校で管弦楽の演奏聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I listened to the orchestra play at school today.
lines.style: Enthusiastic but contained. Slightly breathless on the memory. Talking just a bit faster because it mattered. Soft ending, waiting for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのスマホ、画素が高いのよ
lines.en: Sho, the camera on my phone has such high resolution, you know.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Thoughtful pause before the statement. Speaking more to herself but including him. Reflective, almost musing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夏のお祭りでサンダル履いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I wore sandals to the summer festival.
lines.style: Proud, simple. Direct statement with a small smile in the voice. The satisfaction of remembering a good moment. Steady, uncomplicated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはギタリストみたいに弾けるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father plays guitar almost like a professional musician.
lines.style: Admiring, soft. Slight wonderment in the tone. Talking about someone she respects. Warm delivery, as if sharing something tender about his father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、面白い話で大きなリアクションしちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made a really big reaction when someone told me a funny story.
lines.style: Sheepish, bright. Quick tempo with a slight self-aware laugh underneath. The admission of getting caught up in something. Warm and a little embarrassed.
